description: Implementation of ProductImageService handling image operations such as adding, retrieving, and deleting product images within an e-commerce system. Includes integration with a DAO layer and a content management component.

classes.name: ProductImageServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing product image handling functionalities in the application.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductImage entity by its ID.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple product images to a product, processing each image and storing it.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a single product image, saving image content and updating the database.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists or updates a ProductImage entity.

methods.name: addProductImageDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a ProductImage entity.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image in specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage (by storeCode, productCode, fileName, size)
methods.description: Retrieves a product image in specified size using identifiers.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Gets a list of images associated with a product.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a product image from storage and deletes its record.
